name: pixel-buddies-tools
description: 像素搭子：离线工具链（类型检查、单元测试、像素图与音效生成）。不参与 Cocos 构建。

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run check:wechat-api && npm test
scripts.web:all: npm run web:build && npm run web:package
scripts.mini:check: node mini-config.mjs wechatgame /tmp/pb-wx.json && node mini-config.mjs bytedance-mini-game /tmp/pb-tt.json
scripts.mini:release: RELEASE=1 bash build-mini.sh wechatgame && RELEASE=1 bash build-mini.sh bytedance-mini-game
